details:
Description

When using Steam Frame to play VRChat, I get severe stuttering during loading (world transitions, avatar loading). The stuttering disappears ONLY while the SteamVR dashboard is open, then returns immediately when closed. My output log shows repeated [TextureManagement] Over cache size but failed to find any textures to remove errors, multiple AssetBundleSizeTooLarge avatar download failures, frequent NullReferenceException UI errors, and UdonBehaviour execution halts. Network is stable (packet loss <1%, ping <10ms). Already tested all SteamVR/Steam Frame settings without improvement.

Reproduction Steps

Reproduction Steps:

Launch VRChat via Steam Frame (SteamVR streaming).

Join any world with multiple avatars or moderate player count.

Stuttering occurs consistently during avatar/world loading.

Workarounds Attempted:

None effective. Opening the SteamVR dashboard temporarily reduces stuttering, but it returns immediately upon closing. All SteamVR and Steam Frame settings have been tested without success.
